title: En route to {dest}
riskHit: The risk materialized! You lost {dv} m/s fixing the problem.
insertionHelp: You arrived. Brake just enough: too little and you fly by; too much and you crash. Aim for the green zone.
insertionBudget: You need ~{need} m/s and have {have} m/s left. The red line marks how far your fuel can go.

fuelOut.title: ⛽ Mission failed: out of fuel

when.event: The propellant ran out during cruise. The CubeSat is adrift and can no longer maneuver.
when.arrival: You reached the destination without enough Δv to brake. The CubeSat flew past.
when.burn: The propellant ran out mid-burn. It wasn't enough to stay in orbit.

fuelOut.partial: The propellant ran out during the burn, but it was enough to get captured.
fuelOut.lessonTitle: Why did this happen? The rocket equation
fuelOut.lesson: The propellant you burn is proportional to the mass you push. With your thruster (Isp {isp} s), every kilogram of spacecraft needs {perKg} kg of propellant just for orbit insertion. That's why an oversized CubeSat runs out of fuel.

tips.lighter: Remove instruments or parts that don't serve your science goal.
tips.morePropellant: Load more propellant in the Workshop (if the tank and rocket allow it).
tips.betterIsp: Use a thruster with higher Isp: it burns fewer kg per m/s.
tips.safeChoices: En route, every maneuver costs kg. Risks that materialize cost even more.
